biotools.summary: Jovian is an open-source, virus-focused metagenomic analysis workflow for Illumina data designed to address limitations in clinical diagnostics and surveillance. It generates annotated scaffolds, quality metrics, and interactive reports, demonstrating portability and reproducibility across various IT architectures.
